objections.title: The contract's declared primary metric was never computed; an F4-side quantity was substituted for it and the substitution is undeclared
objections.statement: specification.yaml metrics.primary names D_macaulay_rank_statistic and separation_D_minus_d_F4. Neither was computed. experiments/EXP-SEMBIN-c2c312/code/run_cells.py:148 binds the contract metric name D_macaulay_rank_statistic to the value closure_D, and the computed separation field is separation_closure_minus_dF4. closure_D is defined by code/closure_cert.py as the smallest degree cap at which the ITERATED degree-capped Boolean closure is a Groebner basis, whose stated equivalence is 'G_D is a Groebner basis <=> F4 completes with step degree <= D' -- an F4-side quantity. The instrument the same file labels 'the DREG statistic' (macaulay_single_level, max_iter=1) returns rank, rows, cols and a deficit at an INPUT degree and returns no degree at all. The headline closure_D - d_F4 = 0 is therefore an agreement between two F4-side quantities, not the contract's D - d_F4.
objections.why_fatal: Completion criterion 1 of GOAL-SEMBIN-5078bc requires the map between d_F4 and GOAL-DREG-001's Macaulay-rank d_reg/D 'instrumented on identical instances'. The map instrumented on identical instances is d_F4 <-> closure_D, which is not that map. No instance in the package has the DREG-side statistic and d_F4 both reduced to comparable numbers and differenced, so the criterion's map has no measured value anywhere in the run.
objections.disclosure_status: Not disclosed as a deviation anywhere. manifest.yaml records protocol_deviations: []. The seven deviations in task-report.md and NOTES-deviations-and-limitations.md concern draws, closure draws, field-equation convention, memory caps, closure D=5, single-level D=4 at one cell, and the instrument-identity control scope. None mentions the metric substitution. The run's summary 'all for cost, none for content' is false as to the metric.
objections.what_would_resolve: Either (a) compute D_macaulay_rank_statistic from the single_level rank and deficit columns already committed in results-table.json, under a named choice among the three readings in H-SEMBIN-112e2e.mechanism, and form separation_D_minus_d_F4 over the 31 instances that carry both it and a d_F4 value -- zero runs, exact finite recomputation; or (b) record the substitution as a CONTENT deviation, restate the run's result as a cross-engine consistency check on the closure certificate's equivalence argument, and withhold the DREG map from any decision citing this run.

objections.title: The input-versus-output block is sound for EV-DREG-008 and unsound for GOAL-DREG-001's d_reg outputs; the residual tension is unrecorded
objections.statement: The run's block -- 'its degree parameter D is an input to the instrument, whereas d_F4 and closure_D are outputs' -- is correct for EV-DREG-008: that record's cell is n=12,t=3,ti=0,seed=2026,D=6 with D frozen as a parameter, its output is deficit_genuine=17947 (a rank difference), and its own boundaries block already states 'Structural deficit_genuine != theoretical d_reg'. But GOAL-DREG-001's campaign-level quantity is not only a fixed-degree rank. Its objective asks whether d_reg(n) tracks the semi-regular null 'or departs non-generically (bounded d_reg, or a deficit / gap(n)=d_reg-d_ff that grows with n)'; its completion criterion asks for 'd_reg OR gap(n)=d_reg-d_ff measurements ... evaluated at D up to and including d_reg where reachable' (D swept, d_reg read off as an OUTPUT); and its BATCH-001/BATCH-002 checkpoints report degree outputs: 'analytic linear d_reg law (c*=0.23748, Theta(n))', 'd_reg(sem) >= d_reg(null)=7', 'sem d_ff=2-3'. For those quantities the input/output escape does not apply and the commensurability question is fully open. This run computed no d_reg, no d_ff and no gap, and measured no instance at GOAL-DREG-001's cell.
objections.what_would_resolve: A decision citing this run must scope the block to EV-DREG-008 by name and record explicitly that commensurability between d_F4 and GOAL-DREG-001's d_reg / d_ff / gap(n) outputs remains OPEN and untouched by this run, with a named successor. Dissolving it by generalisation is the failure this objection names.

objections.title: The falsification criterion's consequent is invalid: it conflates a degree at which a Macaulay matrix was BUILT with a degree a system ATTAINS
objections.statement: specification.yaml falsification_criterion: 'D - d_F4 = 0 on every measured instance including the off-diagonal cells refutes the hypothesis ... and GOAL-DREG-001's degree-5/6 measurements WOULD be in tension with Assumption 1.' Even granting a perfect antecedent, the consequent does not follow. EV-DREG-008 reports a rank measurement at a frozen INPUT degree D=6; its output is a rank deficit and its own boundaries deny that this is d_reg. Building a Macaulay matrix at degree 6 asserts nothing about the system's solving degree being 6, so an equality D_DREG = d_F4 could not place it in tension with Assumption 1's bound d_F4 <= 4. The criterion promised an inference the experiment could not have delivered even if executed perfectly. Separately, the contract never defines D_macaulay_rank_statistic by formula, which is the under-specification that admitted OBJ-1's substitution.
objections.antecedent_status: Not satisfied in any case. (i) What was observed is closure_D - d_F4 = 0, not D_DREG - d_F4 = 0. (ii) 'every measured instance including the off-diagonal cells' was not covered: only 1 of the 2 off-diagonal cells produced a separation value; 9 of 126 recorded instances carry one.
objections.what_would_resolve: An additive amendment (never a rewrite) that gives D_macaulay_rank_statistic an explicit formula, and that replaces the consequent with one that is valid: an equality of degree statistics can only bear on Assumption 1 via a DREG quantity that is itself a degree OUTPUT, so the amended criterion must name d_reg / d_ff rather than the input degrees 5 and 6.

objections.title: Proves-too-much object 2: the 5-of-9 unit-ideal split is not reported, and the identity is presented as one fact where it is two
objections.statement: 5 of the 9 map-supporting instances are unsatisfiable (quotient dimension 0). On those, closure_D=4 is decided by verdict_basis '1 in W_D' -- a single containment test. On the 4 satisfiable instances it is decided by 'standard monomials = |V(I)|' -- a quotient-dimension match. Those are structurally different certificates and the report presents their agreement as a single uniform finding. Semaev's own Section 4.5.1 separates the same two cases. The report gives '35 of 43 completed traces are unsatisfiable' -- a statistic over F4 traces -- and never breaks the 9 down by satisfiability. The review plan's declared signature requires exactly that breakdown.
objections.calibration: Material, not fatal. 5 of 9 is a majority but not 'most or all'. Four genuinely satisfiable instances remain, including both reproduction-cell B_equals_1 instances, the off-diagonal (17,3,3,7) at quotient dimension 18, and (19,3,3,7) at 6. The identity is not asserted only where agreement is forced, and I decline to inflate it to fatal.
objections.what_would_resolve: Report the 5/4 split, state that the two sufficiency certificates differ, and restate the map over the 4 satisfiable instances alone. On the committed numbers it still holds at 4 on all four, which makes the claim narrower in scope and stronger in kind.

objections.title: Proves-too-much object 3: a non-evaluable declared control is reported as 'the control the contract asks for'
objections.statement: The matched null's F4 hit the wall cap after 3 rounds, so the null has no d_F4 and hence NO separation (manifest.yaml: null_f4_status unreached_wall_cap, null_f4_d_F4 null, null_closure_D null). The contract's matched_null control is a SEPARATION comparison ('If the separation D - d_F4 is the SAME on the structured and the null system, the separation is a property of the two conventions'), and the contract's third invalidation rule turns on it. Neither was evaluable. Under AGENTS.md rule 5 that non-evaluation is an infrastructure fact and asserts nothing -- the defect is that the run does not report it as a non-evaluation. Instead task-report.md substitutes a closure-sufficiency contrast (structured rank 59530/59536 sufficient vs null 11186/59536 undetermined) and writes 'This is the control the contract asks for'. That single sentence is where the argument survives on an object whose conclusion is false. Consequently the third conjunct of the contract's success_criterion ('the matched-null separation differs from the structured separation') is unevaluated and the report does not say so.
objections.mitigation_recorded: Partial rather than full failure: the substituted contrast rests on a COMPLETED rank measurement on both sides, so it is not an infrastructure artifact, and the report's phrasing 'the verdict does not come out sufficient' is exact -- the recorded verdict is undetermined, not insufficient, and is not upgraded.
objections.scope_note: Validity consequences of a non-evaluated control belong to J-1; this objection reports the argument-level survival only.
objections.what_would_resolve: State in the run record and in any analysis that the matched-null SEPARATION comparison and invalidation rule 3 were not evaluable because the null produced no d_F4, that the third conjunct of success_criterion is therefore unmet, and that the closure-sufficiency contrast is a different and narrower control.

objections.title: A deviation labelled 'for cost' removes half the declared falsification route for the run's own heuristic under test
objections.statement: Deviation 2 ran the closure instrument on draw 0 only. All 9 map-supporting instances are at seed 20260913001, draw 0 (recomputed). HEUR-001 is the contract's heuristic_under_test and its falsification_condition has two arms: variation of D - d_F4 across the R draws within a cell, and variation between B=1 and random B. The R-draw arm is structurally untestable under this deviation, as is the contract's separation_invariance prediction. The B arm survives and shows no variation: (15,5,3,3) carries all four subspace x B variants and (17,3,3,6) both B modes, separation 0 throughout.
objections.what_would_resolve: Record deviation 2 as having a content consequence, and state that HEUR-001's R-draw falsification arm is untested rather than unfalsified. A successor may run the closure on additional draws at the cheapest cell, (15,5,3,3) at N=24, where a degree-4 closure is seconds.

objections.title: Recorded provenance of closure_D's minimality leg cites the F4 instrument on all 9, though an independent recovery exists in the data
objections.statement: closure_D is 'the smallest D with verdict SUFFICIENT', so its minimality leg is the D=3 rejection. On the 5 unit-ideal instances the live D=3 verdict is 'insufficient' with solutions_source 'f4_quotient_dimension' (s=0 taken from the F4 run, passed as s_known at run_cells.py:123). On the 4 satisfiable instances the live D=3 verdict is 'undetermined' and the recovery is summarize.py's posthoc_closure, which takes s = f4.quotient_dimension and records verdict_posthoc_basis naming the F4 instance. So on 9 of 9, the recorded reason closure_D is not 3 is a number the F4 instrument produced. The sufficiency leg at D=4 is independent on all 9 ('1 in W_D' on 5, brute force over free variables on 4).
objections.calibration: Minor, deliberately. An F4-independent recovery exists in the data on all 9: on the unit-ideal instances the D=4 contains_one result proves |V(I)|=0 without F4, and on the satisfiable ones the D=4 brute-force solution count (36, 6, 18, 6) is independent of F4 and exceeds nothing at D=3 where the standard-monomial count is above the 100000 cap. The objection is to the recorded provenance, not to the mathematics.
objections.what_would_resolve: Re-record the D=3 verdict basis citing the closure's own contains_one / brute-force solution count, so that closure_D is demonstrably an F4-independent instrument.

objections.title: Two disclosure gaps, both cutting away from a false alarm
objections.statement: (a) manifest.yaml records protocol_deviations: [] while task-report.md and NOTES list seven. The machine-readable field asserts zero deviations. (Overlaps J-1's validity remit; recorded here because it is part of the disclosure picture for OBJ-1.) (b) manifest.yaml records d_F4_naive_values_over_completed: [3,4,5]; task-report.md discusses only instances below 4 and never mentions the naive 5. The single instance concerned is sem_n12_m6_t6_k2_low_B_ran_s20260913004_d3, whose degree-5 step was empty and is excluded under Semaev's own definition, giving 4. The handling is correct and the omission cuts away from a false alarm rather than toward one, which is why this is minor rather than material.
objections.what_would_resolve: Populate manifest.protocol_deviations with the seven items plus the metric substitution (OBJ-1), and add one sentence to the report naming the single naive-5 instance and why Semaev's reading gives 4.

objects.object: matched-null random dense system (F4 wall-capped after 3 rounds)
objects.finding: The infrastructure half is handled correctly (null_f4_d_F4 recorded null; 'does not come out sufficient' is exact against a recorded verdict of undetermined). The conversion the object predicts does occur, at one identifiable sentence: 'This is the control the contract asks for.' The contract's control is a separation comparison; the null has no separation; a different comparison is substituted and labelled as the contract's. See OBJ-5.

The inference IS blocked for EV-DREG-008, and soundly -- verified independently against that record: cell n=12,t=3,ti=0,seed=2026,D=6 with D frozen, output deficit_genuine=17947, and its own boundaries state 'Structural deficit_genuine != theoretical d_reg'. But it is blocked by EV-DREG-008's own committed text, which predates this run by seven weeks, so the run confirms a block rather than establishing one. It is NOT blocked for GOAL-DREG-001's d_reg / d_ff / gap outputs, which this run never addresses. Per the object's own instruction the residual is an unresolved tension that must be recorded rather than dissolved. Additionally there is no shared cell: DREG's committed cell is n=12,t=3; the SEMBIN set has no (12,3,3,.) and its only n=12 cell, (12,6,6,2), has closure coverage 0 of 15. See OBJ-2.

The argument survives on known-false objects in two specific places: the sentence 'This is the control the contract asks for' (object 3), and the unqualified generalisation from EV-DREG-008 to GOAL-DREG-001 (object 4).

completion_criterion_assessment.reason: The criterion requires the map between d_F4 and GOAL-DREG-001's Macaulay-rank d_reg/D 'instrumented on identical instances'. What was instrumented on identical instances is d_F4 <-> closure_D, an F4-side quantity. The DREG-side instrument produced no degree, was never calibrated against any archived DREG rank (the run records that no such calibration was possible on its host), and no instance shares a cell with GOAL-DREG-001's committed measurement.
completion_criterion_assessment.what_the_run_does_support: A cross-engine, cross-field-equation-convention consistency check on the closure certificate's own truncated-Buchberger equivalence argument, on 9 instances at seed 20260913001 draw 0, n <= 19, N <= 42, with 4 confirmed at both reproduction cells against KN-LIT-fa346d Table 1.
completion_criterion_assessment.not_an_impossibility_claim: This objection does not say the criterion cannot be met, nor that the run's conclusion is false. It says the conclusion is not earned by this run's measurement. The cheapest route to earning it needs zero runs -- see next_concrete_action.

next_concrete_action: Before any Coordinator decision cites RUN-SEMBIN-b6eb9f for completion criterion 1: name which of the three readings in H-SEMBIN-112e2e.mechanism is GOAL-DREG-001's statistic, compute D_macaulay_rank_statistic from the single_level rank and deficit columns already committed in results-table.json, and form separation_D_minus_d_F4 over the 31 instances that carry both it and a d_F4 value. Zero runs, exact finite recomputation, 3.4x the instances the substitute rests on, and it produces the metric the contract actually declared.
